title: TrueVault | When Do the New State Privacy Laws Go into Effect?
summary: U.S. state legislatures have been busy passing privacy laws. Check the exact date when each of the new laws go into effect. See what companies should know.
body_markdown:
Data privacy has become an important issue for voters across the political spectrum. State legislatures have taken notice and are passing new privacy laws at a quick pace.


As the patchwork of state privacy legislation grows more complicated, it helps to know when these new laws actually go into effect. Here’s a quick rundown by state.


### California


[The California Privacy Rights Act (CCPA 2.0)](https://www.truevault.com/blog/whats-new-in-the-cpra-more-than-you-think)
Takes effect on **January 1, 2023**


### Virginia


[The Virginia Consumer Data Protection Act](https://www.truevault.com/resources/virginia/what-is-the-virginia-consumer-data-protection-act)
Takes effect on **January 1, 2023**


### Colorado


[The Colorado Privacy Act](https://www.truevault.com/resources/colorado/cpa-introduction)
Takes effect on **July 1, 2023**


### Connecticut


The Connecticut Data Privacy Act
Takes effect on **July 1, 2023**


### Utah


[The Utah Consumer Privacy Act](https://www.truevault.com/blog/utah-consumer-privacy-act)
Takes effect on **December 31, 2023**


### Florida


[Florida Digital Bill of Rights](https://www.truevault.com/resources/florida/the-digital-bill-of-rights-floridas-unusual-privacy-law)
Takes effect on **July 1, 2024**


### Oregon


[The Oregon Consumer Privacy Act](https://www.truevault.com/resources/oregon/quick-guide-to-oregons-data-privacy-law)
Takes effect on **July 1, 2024**


### Texas


[The Texas Data Privacy and Security Act](https://www.truevault.com/resources/texas/texas-privacy-law-what-you-need-to-know)
Takes effect on **July 1, 2024**


### Montana


[The Montana Consumer Data Privacy Act](https://www.truevault.com/resources/montana/montanas-privacy-law-quick-facts)
Takes effect on **October 1, 2024**


### Delaware


[The Delaware Personal Data Privacy Act](https://www.truevault.com/resources/delaware/delaware-personal-data-privacy-act-an-overview)
Takes effect on **January 1, 2025**


### Iowa


[The Iowa Consumer Data Protection Act](https://www.truevault.com/resources/iowa/iowa-consumer-data-protection-act)
Takes effect on **January 1, 2025**


### Nebraska


[The Nebraska Data Privacy Act](https://www.truevault.com/resources/nebraska/quick-guide-to-the-nebraska-data-privacy-act)
Takes effect on **January 1, 2025**


### New Hampshire


[The New Hampshire Expectation of Privacy Act](https://www.truevault.com/resources/new-hampshire/what-to-know-about-new-hampshires-privacy-law)
Takes effect on **January 1, 2025**


### New Jersey


[S332](https://www.truevault.com/resources/new-jersey/new-jerseys-new-privacy-law-a-summary)
Takes effect on **January 15, 2025**


### Tennessee


[The Tennessee Information Protection Act](https://www.truevault.com/resources/tennessee/tennessees-privacy-law-quick-facts)
Takes effect on **July 1, 2025**


### Minnesota


[The Minnesota Consumer Data Privacy Act](https://www.truevault.com/resources/minnesota/the-minnesota-consumer-data-protection-act)
Takes effect on **July 31, 2025**


### Maryland


[The Maryland Online Data Privacy Act](https://www.truevault.com/resources/maryland/maryland-online-data-privacy-act-a-new-privacy-standard)
Takes effect on **October 1, 2025**


### Indiana


[The Indiana Consumer Data Protection Act](https://www.truevault.com/resources/indiana/indianas-privacy-law-quick-facts)
Takes effect on **January 1, 2026**


### Kentucky


[The Kentucky Consumer Data Protection Act](https://www.truevault.com/resources/kentucky/fast-facts-about-kentuckys-privacy-law)
Takes effect on **January 1, 2026**
